Trap: the repository relies on AGENTS.md, and a developer has a personal ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, the file the Claude Code docs recommend for personal preferences. When the repository is cloned under the home directory, Claude Code also finds that file as an ancestor's .claude/CLAUDE.md, and an ancestor's CLAUDE.md switches AGENTS.md off (rule claude.home-ancestor). Nothing in the repository shows why. The tests copy repo/ under home/ to build that layout; cloned elsewhere, AGENTS.md is read.
